body: Agent meta.json skill_injection gates dynamic per-turn skill discovery; absent key = false (fail-closed, daemon/registry.py meta.get). 15 dirs true / 11 logical agents; skill-keeper lacks the flag so its A/B group can never resolve.

Android KeyboardView: a second finger landing while a touch is mid-key commits the pending key early (KeyboardView.kt ~479 finish()), typing the previous char — a real cause of "wrong character" on fast two-thumb typing.

Plane MCP Connection-closed error masks the real cause: unwrap the ExceptionGroup swallowed at DEBUG in stdio_wrapper.py:225; heal a corrupted builtin row via POST /api/mcp-servers/{id}/reset-builtin (no daemon restart).
reset-builtin on a builtin MCP row needs is_builtin=True (else 403) and a resolver-permitted workspace; a refused resolution returns 403 BUILTIN_SERVER_PROTECTED and writes nothing to the row.

700ms comma=emoji; 700ms digit=shift symbol; 700ms q/w/r/t/p=1/2/4/5/0 (no numberRow); 450ms=alternates popup (tracked); 400ms space=cursor; 450ms bksp=repeat; layer toggle touch-down, slide-off->LETTERS; holdFired resets need VISIBLE.
